description: This file defines the EncryptedPayload class, which extends PurePayload and implements EncryptedPayloadInterface. It encapsulates encrypted data payloads with methods for cloning and retrieving the payload in a transfer-ready format.

classes.name: EncryptedPayload
classes.description: Represents an encrypted data payload extending PurePayload, including encryption-specific properties and methods for payload management.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes an EncryptedPayload instance from a raw encrypted payload and optional source.

methods.name: ejected
methods.description: Returns a plain object representing the payload suitable for transfer or storage.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the current payload with optional property overrides.

methods.name: copyAsSyncResolved
methods.description: Creates a copy of the payload as a SyncResolvedPayload, with optional property overrides.

ctags.name: EncryptedPayload
ctags.pattern: /^export class EncryptedPayload extends PurePayload<EncryptedTransferPayload> implements Encrypted/
